chunks: By Allah, I have patched this shirt of mine so much that I became shy of the one who patched it. And a speaker said to me: 'Will you not discard it?' So I said: 'Get away from me.' For in the morning people praise the night journey.

key_terms.مِدْرَعَة: A type of shirt or tunic

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali's story about his patched shirt teach about humility and patience?
ai.summary: This narration, often cited in discussions of Imam Ali’s asceticism (zuhd), highlights his deliberate rejection of worldly vanity by wearing a heavily patched shirt until he felt shy of the mender. The concluding proverb, 'in the morning the people will praise the night journey,' underscores the Shia scholarly view that true spiritual endurance and leadership are validated through patience and eventual divine recognition, rather than immediate public acclaim.
